versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the copywriting skill focused on text optimization and wording adjustment.
- Supports multiple roles (e.g., product owner, reportee, team member) and scenarios (e.g., reporting to boss, replying to customer service, group chat).
- Provides style and content depth adjustment for various audiences.
- Enables simplification, formalization, conversational tone, and Chinese/English switching.
- Outlines clear guidelines for wording in different communication contexts such as reports, emails, and group messages.
